sentences.text:
-----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
-----

For the Petitioner : Mr. A.K. Sahani, Advocate For the State : Mr. Mukul Kumar Singh, A.C. to G.P.-III -----
05/08.08.2024 Heard Mr. A.K. Sahani, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Mukul Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the State.

2. The prayer in the writ petition is made for quashing the order dated 26.04.2022 passed by respondent no.3 in Misc. Case No.29 of 2021-22, whereby, a sum of Rs.10,030/- per decimal has been fixed as compensation for acquisition of land.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the impugned order is a common order and that is being illegally applied to the petitioner.
He submits that objection has also been filed.
4. Learned counsel for the State submits that the petitioner has to move before the Arbitrator or District Land Acquisition Officer in light of Section 3G(5) of National Highways Act, 1956.

5. In view of the above, this writ petition is being disposed of with direction to the petitioner to move before the aforesaid authority, who will look into the matter and pass appropriate order, in Purushottam Lal Tibrewal vs The State Of Jharkhand Through Its Chief ... on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55448161/
1 accordance with law.
